title: The PR ledger stacks pull requests by base ref.
ruling: Stack by base ref stands (coordinator pick, 12:01 CST Nov 12, PR 2845): the ledger stacks a PR by its base ref, not by a Based on line in the body. All four 72 hour limits are retired under the owner's R37: fixed numbers he did not rule are retired or derived from measured runs. Three (fix check, fresh full review, lane round 2 or later) were retired at 12:14 CST Nov 15 (coordinator pick, relayed; not owner-typed; undoable). The fourth (lane lint at 72 hours, counted in the longest wait; the lane's own pick, 12:13 CST Nov 12) is retired too, by the coordinator's pick relayed 12:17 CST Nov 15 (not owner-typed; undoable). The PR 2845 lane applies all four when it rebases. Unchanged: a done record with no lane-lint PASS reads lane lint, owner the lane; a held, parked or replaced label with no valid Waits on line reads none and red, even on a draft.
quote: Coordinator picks used (12:01 CST Nov 12): stack by base ref ... 72 h for fix check, fresh full review and lane round 2+
